ignore.title: Left out of the backup
ignore.description: Files matching these patterns stay on each computer and are kept when a sync updates the skill.
ignore.hint: One pattern per line, written like a .gitignore. They apply on all your devices. Files already backed up stay in the backup.

backupSync.removed_one: Deleted on {{device}}: {{names}}. It is in Recently removed if you want it back.
backupSync.removed_other: Deleted on another device: {{names}}. They are in Recently removed if you want them back.
